correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 64 complex quartic line equations over Q(omega,i), tested every pair, checked the degree-18 graph and exact five-term spectral certificate. The 63x63 reduced Laplacian modular Smith pivot certificates at 2,3,7,11 determine all 63 valuations, with precision p^16 above maximum valuation nine. The matrix-tree determinant has valuation (209,9,2,8) and confirms no omitted primes; p-adic lists combine to Smith factors 1^18,4^2,16^32,32,64,192,4224^6,118272^2. The resulting group equals the torsion of coker(16I-M) by the standard connected graph Laplacian theorem. Standalone verifier ran successfully.

value.rationale: The line arrangement is the maximal classical quartic K3 line configuration, and its integral shifted-intersection cokernel is canonically associated to the geometry through the graph Laplacian 16I-M. Classifying the entire finite critical group gives precise chip-firing obstruction classes and maximum exponent 118272. These integer obstructions are not implied by rational intersection rank, graph spectrum or tree count. This is a complete natural integral invariant, not an arbitrary slice or a mere reparameterization.
